mapper.sql: w.id, w.user_id, w.region_id, w.title, w.start_date, w.end_date, w.business_budget_total, w.personal_budget_total, w.status, w.settled_at, w.created_at, w.updated_at, r.name AS region_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workations ( user_id, region_id, title, start_date, end_date, business_budget_total, personal_budget_total, status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{regionId}, #{title}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{businessBudgetTotal}, #{personalBudgetTotal}, 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM workations w JOIN region r ON r.id = w.region_id WHERE w.id = #{id}

SELECT
FROM workations w JOIN region r ON r.id = w.region_id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} AND w.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY w.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT budget_type AS budgetType, SUM(amount) AS spentTotal FROM workation_expenses WHERE workation_id = #{workationId} GROUP BY budget_type
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workation_expenses WHERE workation_id = #{workationId} AND is_auto_categorized = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workations WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT w.id, w.title, w.start_date, w.end_date, w.status, w.settled_at, w.region_id, r.name AS region_name, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.budget_type = 'WORK' THEN e.amount END), 0) AS business_spent_total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.budget_type = 'PERSONAL' THEN e.amount END), 0) AS personal_spent_total FROM workations w JOIN region r ON r.id = w.region_id LEFT JOIN workation_expenses e ON e.workation_id = w.id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} AND w.status = 'SETTLED' GROUP BY w.id, w.title, w.start_date, w.end_date, w.status, w.settled_at, w.region_id, r.name ORDER BY w.settled_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workations WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'SETTLED'
mapper.update: UPDATE workations SET title = #{title}, region_id = #{regionId}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, business_budget_total = #{businessBudgetTotal}, personal_budget_total = #{personalBudgetTotal}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workation_expenses WHERE workation_id = #{workationId} AND (DATE(spent_at) < #{startDate} OR DATE(spent_at) > #{endDate})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workation_expenses WHERE workation_id = #{workationId} AND transaction_id IS NULL AND (DATE(spent_at) < #{startDate} OR DATE(spent_at) > #{endDate})

SELECT r.id AS reservation_id, r.reservation_code, m.name AS merchant_name, rp.product_name, rp.product_detail_type, r.start_date, r.end_date, r.status FROM reservations r JOIN reservation_products rp ON rp.id = r.product_id JOIN merchants m ON m.id = rp.merchant_id WHERE r.workation_id = #{workationId} AND r.status <> 'CANCELED' ORDER BY r.start_date, r.id
mapper.update: UPDATE workations SET status = 'SETTLED', settled_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM workations w JOIN region r ON r.id = w.region_id WHERE w.start_date = #{startDate} AND w.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT
FROM workations w JOIN region r ON r.id = w.region_id WHERE w.end_date = #{endDate} AND w.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT
FROM workations w JOIN region r ON r.id = w.region_id WHERE w.status = 'ACTIVE' AND DATE_ADD(w.end_date, INTERVAL 3 DAY) <= #{cutoffDate}

SELECT w.user_id AS userId, w.id AS workationId, COUNT(*) AS uncheckedCount FROM workations w JOIN workation_expenses we ON we.workation_id = w.id WHERE w.status = 'ACTIVE' AND we.is_auto_categorized = 1 GROUP BY w.user_id, w.id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
